status: review-only; not configured as a backup job

approved_policy.exclude: verified redownloadable game installation files and torrent payloads

payload_exclusion_requirements.steam: Exact file matches installed depot content hash; changed/extra files and selected state/config remain included. Revalidate on captured source.
payload_exclusion_requirements.torrents: Exact metadata mapping, payload integrity and redownload availability must be established; extra/unverified files remain included.
payload_exclusion_requirements.other_games: Explicit verified replacement source and retained unique-state inventory required; otherwise include.

capture_requirements: Refresh the mount/subvolume inventory; restrict physical sources to NVMe root and ESP.
No traversal of foreign mounts or symlinks to external storage.
Use application-consistent exports or a reviewed consistent checkpoint; do not trust live database file copies alone.
Rebase canonical paths/exclusions onto the actual capture root; this manifest is not an executable exclude file.
Native Restic encrypted offsite copy, available quota/reserve checked before upload.
Isolated disk-backed restore batches must cover every retained manifest entry and preserve numeric owners, permissions, ACLs, xattrs and hard links.
production_boot_gates: Verified offsite capture and isolated restore coverage
Independent rescue media and key tested locally
Real-store and ESP boot plus persistent-root fallback proven
Local-console first boot and second reboot
